title: Preview: the campaign video, narrated (digital twin, simulated benchmark)
description:
A preview, for review: the narrated campaign video's opening (what is simulated and what is real), then the replay's switch from day 1 to the animated 3-D lab and the first view of the whole lab from above. Simulated, not lab results.

The voice is synthetic: Kokoro v1.0 (open weights, run locally), its stock voice af_heart, no voice cloned or imitated. What it says, at its times in this preview:
0:00  This is a simulated benchmark: two alloy discovery campaigns, replayed for a whole year in a digital twin of our planned automated lab.
0:10  Some of it comes from real sources: the lab's design and its 3-D model, footage from our own atomizer, the search spaces in the two proposals, and published prices. Everything else is simulated: every alloy, every measurement, and every result.
0:28  From day two, the event log moves the lab's 3-D model: each booking brings its tray to a Shuttle's opening and back, and a mobile arm drives over to serve it. Trays nobody has booked stay in their slots.
0:44  Now the whole lab from above, with the two Shuttles up close from a second camera. The moves run on a clock of their own, so you can follow them; the panel at the bottom counts how many were drawn.
